description: This Java class serves as a command handler for closing a group within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the close group operation to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService. Annotated with Spring's @Service, @CommandType, and @Transactional, it processes commands to close a group identified by entity ID.

classes.name: CloseGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the command to close a group in the Fineract platform by delegating the operation to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CloseGroupCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the close group command by invoking the closeGroup method on the service, passing the entity ID and command details.
